outcome: distance between the placenta and the internal cervical os
cohort: 328 women with singleton live pregnancies complicated by placenta previa and/or accreta
finding: A short cervical length (<30 mm) was significantly associated with a higher risk of several adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes in pregnancies complicated by placenta previa and/or accreta.
mod_finding: Women with short cervical length in pregnancies complicated by placenta previa and/or accreta had significantly higher rates of emergency cesarean sections.
